profile.name: Maged Gadalla
profile.title: Senior Unity & XR Developer
profile.tagline: VR / AR / MR simulations, real-time multiplayer and educational games
profile.about: Unity & XR software engineer with 4+ years of experience designing and shipping interactive simulations, real-time networking systems and multiplayer games. I focus on clean architecture, design patterns and stable performance on standalone headsets such as Meta Quest 2 and Quest 3.

points: Architect VR and MR simulations on the Meta XR All-in-One SDK
Strategy and Command patterns with a hierarchical state machine and undo/redo
Meta Voice SDK with bilingual Arabic and English voice detection
Profiling and memory work for stable frame rates on Quest 2 and Quest 3
Full development cycle for VR apps and 2D/3D educational games
Reusable systems and scenarios across platforms
Profiling and debugging with QA across 2D, 3D and VR
Battle Royale systems and real-time player synchronization
REST APIs for dynamic game data
OAuth 2.0 login with Google and Facebook
Core architecture for a real-time farming simulation
Custom API syncing progression, inventory and game state
Scene layout and level design for better rendering performance
